flags: Long-stay test 5 (an RV park, not a home community) looks FAILED: the park sells manufactured homes and park models ('Manufactured Homes Pre-Owned & New - Homes For Sale', park models for sale, 'Our base lot rent starts at $630 a month', 'We currently have another 130+ homes to put into our community'; park-model land lease Nov-Apr $4,650/season). Nights are posted ($77 daily) and sold by phone, but it is a manufactured-home community with an RV section. In AWH's Fort Myers exception, so a human decides.
Nothing turns away a 23-ft Class C: daily rate covers RVs up to 34 ft; occupancy is priced on 1-2 persons with $5/day extra, not a single-occupancy rule.
